moments.author: Angel Reese
moments.quote: Angel Reese now holds the WNBA records for most rebounds in a single game (26) and a single season (458).
moments.why: Historic WNBA rebounding records have fans and men 25‑45 buzzing.

moments.author: Jordan Schultz
moments.quote: BREAKING: The Browns are naming Deshaun Watson as their starting QB, Shedeur Sanders will be the backup.
moments.why: Watson’s QB1 decision ignites debate over Cleveland’s direction and Sanders’ future.
